I am taking two weeks off and want you to help me plan those two weeks.

I am married and have a three-year-old daughter. She goes to school Monday through Thursday and needs to be there before 9. I leave at 8:30 to take her. Friday she stays home with me while my wife works.

We have a golden retriever. I walk the dog in the morning and want to take a walk after every meal.

Fitness is a big part of my life. I want to go to the gym Monday through Saturday and rest Sunday. Monday through Thursday I can go after school drop-off. Friday and Saturday I want it to be the first major thing I do in the morning.

I eat three meals and want to try an 18:6 eating window, finishing by 4pm. I want to cook most meals.

I also need to call the pediatrician, schedule my PCP, handle FMLA with my PCP and Matrix, schedule a dental cleaning, find a psychiatrist for an ADHD evaluation, and find a therapist for burnout. I want those handled as early as possible, but I do not necessarily want a calendar block for every call.

I want to clean the house gradually, do about two hours of overseeding, finish a YouTube video that has about three hours of work left, then split remaining focused work roughly equally between my app and YouTube.

After I pick up my daughter, I want family time rather than focused work. Weekends should also mostly be family time.

I procrastinate when I only have a long todo list, so I want help knowing what the best next action is.

Help me plan the two weeks.
